note: poiFloating and poiBuried are GATED; the two instance counts are reported only. A POI compound where EVERY mesh is clear of the drawn ground has no benign reading, and those two counts are structural -- every site is force-built every run. poiFloating is pinned at 0 and is NOT a measured value: it was 0 when the gate landed and 13 after the 2026-08-24 terrain reshape, and baselining that would have hidden the regression the gate exists to find. The instance counts are dominated by stacked rock courses, which rest on rock rather than soil and are a float by arithmetic and not by defect; gating them needs one boolean per instance saying it is meant to be grounded, which lives in the placers, not here.
